summary.text: Jamie Sonneberger is the Democratic candidate for Michigan House of Representatives District 63 in the November 3, 2026 general election, after defeating Robert Kelly-McFarland in the August 4, 2026 primary.
He serves on the board of the Anchor Bay School District and, in a 2026 Ballotpedia survey, described himself as an educator and school board trustee.

paragraphs.text: Jamie Sonneberger earned a high school diploma from Henry Ford II High School and a bachelor's degree from the University of Michigan at Flint in 2025.
He told Ballotpedia in 2026 that he has worked in classrooms, driven a school bus, and gone back to college later in life.
Ballotpedia lists his career experience as administrator and his office as an at-large seat in the Anchor Bay School District.
Sonneberger said public school funding is a central issue in his campaign and called for steady leadership and on-time, responsible education funding.
He also said he has supported local efforts such as the Anchor Bay Band Boosters, an animal rescue, and a local fishing club.
